(
  set -euo pipefail
  EXP=${PROJECT}/experiments/ekr0601_transition_v1

  if [ ! -e "$EXP/protocol/session_env.sh" ]; then
    cat > "$EXP/protocol/session_env.sh" <<'SH'
export ROOT=${PROJECT}
export SRC="$ROOT/src/KCC0601_v1"
export LEGACY="$ROOT/experiments/kcc0601_glove_mvp_v1"
export PROJ="$ROOT/src/EKR0601_transition_v1"
export EXP="$ROOT/experiments/ekr0601_transition_v1"

export BANK_ROOT="$ROOT/knowledge/ekr0601_transition_v1/description_bank_v1"
export GLOVE="$ROOT/data/glove/glove.6B.300d.txt"
export CPF_PY="$CPF_PY"
export GPU=2
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPU"
cd "$PROJ"
SH
  fi
  cat "$EXP/protocol/session_env.sh"
)
source ${PROJECT}/experiments/ekr0601_transition_v1/protocol/session_env.sh

    --knowledge-root "$KNOWLEDGE" --out-root "$BANK_ROOT" \
    --glove "$GLOVE" --datasets ut-zap50k mit-states cgqa \
    --permutation-seed 1729 \

)

source ${PROJECT}/experiments/ekr0601_transition_v1/protocol/session_env.sh

  # 3351四项配置已在第4节生成；另两个seed在第5节生成。

    for variant in A_raw A_unit C_text C_shuffle; do

    done

      runs+=("branch_ut-zappos_${variant}_s${seed}_e10")
    done
  done
  "$CPF_PY" -m transition.cli freeze-final --exp "$EXP" --legacy-exp "$LEGACY" \

(
  set -euo pipefail
  source ${PROJECT}/experiments/ekr0601_transition_v1/protocol/session_env.sh
  PROTOCOL="$EXP/protocol/final_test_ut_v1.json"
  "$CPF_PY" - "$PROTOCOL" <<'PY'
import json, os, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
protocol = Path(sys.argv[1])
exp = Path(os.environ['EXP'])
for run in json.loads(protocol.read_text())['runs']:
    for setting in ('cw', 'ow'):
        out = exp / 'final_test_v1' / run['run_id'] / setting
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-u', '-m', 'transition.cli', 'eval',
            '--cfg', run['config'], '--load', run['checkpoint'],
            '--phase', 'test', '--setting', setting, '--protocol', str(protocol),
            '--out', str(out)], check=True)
PY
)

source ${PROJECT}/experiments/ekr0601_transition_v1/protocol/session_env.sh
RID=branch_ut-zappos_R5_s3351_e3
ps -u "$USER" -o pid,etime,pcpu,pmem,args
tail -n 30 "$EXP/runs/$RID/train.log"
cat "$EXP/runs/$RID/status.json"

  set -euo pipefail

"$CPF_PY" install.py \
  --source ${PROJECT}/src/KCC0601_v1 \
  --destination ${PROJECT}/src/EKR0601_transition_v1
cd ${PROJECT}/src/EKR0601_transition_v1
"$CPF_PY" -m transition.cli --help

(
  set -euo pipefail
  source ${PROJECT}/experiments/ekr0601_transition_v1/protocol/session_env.sh
  TOOL="$ROOT/tools/semantic_gate_audit_20261006_v1"
  REPORT="$EXP/reports/semantic_ut_3seed_diskretry_20261006_141852"
  test -s "$REPORT/runs.csv"
  test -s "$REPORT/collection.json"

  GATE=$("$CPF_PY" - "$EXP" "$REPORT" <<'PY'
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
exp, report = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
fingerprint = json.loads((report / 'collection.json').read_text())['fingerprint']
matches = []
for path in sorted((exp / 'protocol').glob('semantic_gate*.json')):
    record = json.loads(path.read_text())
    if record.get('report_fingerprint') == fingerprint:
        matches.append(path)
if len(matches) != 1:
    print('STOP: expected one gate matching this report; found ' + str(len(matches)), file=sys.stderr)
    for path in matches:
        print(path, file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(1)
print(matches[0])
PY
  )
  printf 'MATCHED_GATE=%s\n' "$GATE"
  STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
  AUDIT="$EXP/diagnostics/semantic_gate_audit_${STAMP}"
  mkdir -p "$EXP/launch_logs"

  set +e
  "$CPF_PY" -I -u "$TOOL/audit_semantic_gate.py" \
    --root "$ROOT" --project "$PROJ" --exp "$EXP" --legacy-exp "$LEGACY" \
    --report "$REPORT" --gate "$GATE" \
    --out "$AUDIT" \
    2>&1 | tee "$EXP/launch_logs/semantic_gate_audit_${STAMP}.log"
  pipeline_codes=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
  RC=${pipeline_codes[0]}
  if [ "$RC" -eq 0 ] && [ "${pipeline_codes[1]}" -ne 0 ]; then
    RC=${pipeline_codes[1]}
  fi
  set -e

  printf 'AUDIT_EXIT_CODE=%s\nAUDIT_DIRECTORY=%s\n' "$RC" "$AUDIT"
  if [ -s "$AUDIT/audit_summary.md" ]; then
    cat "$AUDIT/audit_summary.md"
  fi
  if [ "$RC" -ne 0 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'STOP: inspect the audit failure. Do not retrain or change the gate yet.'
    exit "$RC"
  fi
  printf '%s\n' 'Audit finished. Integrity pass does not imply research gate pass.'
)

(
  set -euo pipefail
  EXP=${PROJECT}/experiments/ekr0601_transition_v1
  CPF_PY="$CPF_PY"
  "$CPF_PY" - "$EXP" <<'PY'
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
files = sorted((Path(sys.argv[1]) / 'diagnostics').glob('semantic_gate_audit_*/audit.json'))
if not files:
    raise SystemExit('STOP: no completed audit JSON found')
path = files[-1]
x = json.loads(path.read_text())
print('AUDIT_FILE:', path)
print('INTEGRITY_PASSED:', x['integrity_passed'])

import shutil, sys
from pathlib import Path
import yaml
exp, filename = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
cfg = yaml.safe_load(filename.read_text())
expected = exp / "runs/semantic_ut-zappos_C_shuffle_s2026_e10"
if Path(cfg["TRAIN"]["kcc_run_dir"]).resolve() != expected.resolve():
    raise SystemExit("STOP: config points to another run")
if cfg["TRAIN"]["seed"] != 2026 or cfg["TRAIN"]["max_epoch"] != 10:
    raise SystemExit("STOP: seed or budget mismatch")
if cfg["TRAIN"]["start_epoch"] != 1 or cfg["TRAIN"]["kcc_variant"] != "C_shuffle":

PY
